INSERT INTO quotation (quotation_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type, weight_kg, estimated_amount, estimated_currency, valid_until, created_by, created_at, projected_at) VALUES (#{quotationId}, #{originUnLocode}, #{destinationUnLocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{cargoType}, #{weightKg}, #{estimatedAmount}, #{estimatedCurrency}, #{validUntil}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{projectedAt})
ON CONFLICT (quotation_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO quotation_candidate (quotation_id, candidate_seq, voyage_numbers, transit_days, estimated_cost, estimated_currency, overdue_days) VALUES (#{quotationId}, #{candidateSeq}, #{voyageNumbers}, #{transitDays}, #{estimatedCost}, #{estimatedCurrency}, #{overdueDays})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
